thread:
lee_sales: Heads-up - OrbitSync (prospect) wants a short Day-0 playbook + success criteria ahead of Tue kickoff 10am PT. Can SE + Security join?

noah_se: I can. Need to know which flows they care about (summaries, rerank, chat) and sample volumes. Also what latency/throughput expectations are for pricing.

jules_pm: Proposed KPIs: gen p95 < 350ms, resume-summary accept rate >= 80%, rerank MRR improvement >= 10%, 2-week eval window, rollback if quality drops > 8%.

anya_security: They asked about SSO + KMS + logging. If they require VPC peering or on-prem ingest that's a blocker for a quick hosted trial. Ask legal for DPA before uploading samples.

lee_sales: Intake says three priorities: 1) candidate resume summarize, 2) search rerank, 3) interview coach. Rachel says samples ready but needs DPA.

rachel_cust: Confirming hosted first. We'll upload anonymized samples to your S3 once DPA signed. Need pricing for 3-month reserved vs PAYG.

noah_se: I'll prepare prompt templates and a tiny eval harness (50 items per use case) and a curl smoke test.

jules_pm: I'll draft the one-pager success criteria + two pricing scenarios (reserved pool w/ discount, PAYG) for kickoff.

anya_security: I'll send DPA + checklist and list any private-deploy lead times.

deploy-bot: Meeting created: "Redwood - OrbitSync POC Kickoff" Tue 10:00am PT (45m).

lee_sales: Action list: noah (eval harness) / anya (DPA) / jules (success criteria & pricing) / lee (request sample upload link). All due Mon EOD. React :thumbsup: when acked.

rachel_cust: Thanks all. Hosted is fine to start. See you Tue.

(noisy but short thread; will post minutes after kickoff.)
